newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RMB launches Australian electricity index.
newsitem.headline: RMB launches Australian electricity index.

text.p: RMB Australia Ltd said on Thursday it had launched an electricity index to measure the value of the electricity market compared with electricity contract prices based on normal business payment cycle.

RMB Australia said the RMB Electricity Index will be a guide to the final settlement price of the Sydney Futures Exchange Electricity Futures Contract, a monthly average price contract due to begin trading in the third quarter of 1997.
The futures price at maturity will converge with the RMB Electricity Index, said RMB Australia, a unit of South Africa's Rand Merchant Bank.
RMBA said the electricity contract will incorporate a 30 day rolling straight average of half hour spot electricity prices calculated and reported live every 30 minutes.
It said the index has been designed so that all half hour prices in the index period are incorporated into an average which smooths out the volatility of electricity spot prices.
The bank said this provides a clear indication of price movements without the distortion of short term price spikes from plant shutdowns or seasonal demand peaks.
RMBA said the index has been launched as a free information service and is available from its Internet site www.rmb.com.au.
